title: Compact morphology code bank with damage recovery
hypothesis: One shared local repair rule plus compact morphology codes reconstructs and recovers 16 patterns from 30% damage with at least 25% fewer complete bytes than storing independent morphology targets.
physical_object: shared local recurrent target-repair update rule
mirror_coordinate: per-morphology angle, phase, frequency and bias code

development.selection_metric: actual complete bytes, final target nRMSE, recovery fraction, stencil and generator operation proxy

fresh.reason: training-free analytic screen; no independent audit after exact native analytic code alias

paid_objects: all target maps for independent bank

success_gate: Mean final target nRMSE <=0.02, recovery fraction >=0.95, >=25% complete byte savings, and strict quality-byte-compute improvement over native analytic code and hard tying.
failure_gate: Quality/recovery/byte gate miss or exact native analytic morphology-code function/payload alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Procedurally generated smooth sinusoidal target maps with a fixed local relaxation rule; not a learned NCA.
Damage is random cell replacement; no self-organized growth, regeneration dynamics, or biological morphology claim.
